title: brassica perviridis
intro: Brassica perviridis, commonly known as Chinese flowering mustard or Chinese kale, is a plant species from the Brassicaceae family. It is a nutrient-rich vegetable that offers various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Chinese flowering mustard include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood pressure, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
